question: _______ in our body is a cartilaginous box which helps in sound production.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Larynx**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **The larynx** is also known as the **voice box**.
 
• It is an **organ** located in the **anterior neck**.
 
• **Functions** of the larynx **include**:
 
 
• **Production of sound or phonation**
 
• **Control of ventilation**
 
• **The cough reflex**
 
• **Protection of the lower respiratory tract**
 
 
 
• **​The larynx **is covered **anteriorly** by the **infrahyoid muscles**, and **laterally** by the **lobes of the thyroid gland**.
 
• The structure of the larynx is **cartilaginous** and is held by a series of **ligaments and membranes**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0e7f4dca1f883e58c056275e0a201d249a4e766255ae74223b1c12a81ea1877f.png] 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
 

 **Alveoli**
 
 
 
• Alveoli are **tiny, balloon-shaped air sacs**.
 
• They move **oxygen and carbon dioxide** molecules **into** and** out** of the **bloodstream**
 
 
 
 

 **Epiglottis**
 
 
 
• It is a **small**, movable **lid** above the **larynx **that **prevents** food and drink from **entering our windpipe**.
 
 
 
 

 **Pleura**
 
 
 
• It is a **layer of tissue** that **covers** the** lungs** and lines the **interior wall** of the **chest cavity**.
